newsitem.title: USA: Texaco sells Captain Field stake.
newsitem.headline: Texaco sells Captain Field stake.

text.p: Texaco Inc said Korea Petroleum Development Corp has purchased a 15 percent interest in the Captain Field in the British North Sea for $210 million.

Texaco said it will continue to operate the field. The sale includes 15 percent of both Captain Area A, which began to produce oil March 6, and Area B where first production is expected around the turn of the century.
Texaco called the alliance "a strategic one," saying it gives the company an investment partment and "a valuable business relationship" with Korea Petroleum.
"Hopefully (the relationship) will help Texaco to explor opportunities in the Far East and other emerging markets."
